scope: Additive TH18 Thrower L1-L4 direct-parent ranged baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; the official correction does not publish a client build.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms the L4 correction to 2,800 HP and 240 DPS, but no range, cadence, target, projectile or timing contract.

sources.title: Thrower — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L4 HP/DPS, 6-tile range, 2.5-second cadence, 18 movement speed, 16 housing space and ground-and-air single-target attack. It does not measure projectile launch, travel, impact, collision or retarget ordering.

sources.title: Thrower
sources.limitations: Corroborates the four-level table, no building preference, ground-and-air targets, range, cadence and housing. It describes hero, Clan Castle and Skeleton Trap retargeting, which requires excluded actor families and is not implemented.

support.note: The source-backed direct-parent range and ordinary-building path use the shared Core projectile route through Headless, Viewer and RL; unmeasured projectile timing and excluded-actor retargeting remain partial.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Thrower projectile launch, travel, target-loss, collision, impact boundary, fixed-tick ordering or visual timing; the shared one-logical-tick projectile remains an explicit unmeasured fallback.

The described priority against heroes, Clan Castle troops and Skeleton Trap Skeletons cannot be represented without out-of-scope or separately incomplete actor families, so no approximation is enabled.
Exact target ties, line-of-sight, route topology and visual assets remain unpublished or unverified.
conclusion: Thrower L1-L4 has source-backed direct-parent values and an ordinary-building ranged Core baseline. Its projectile timing, special retargeting and geometry remain partial rather than inferred.
